title: Corporate Account Rollback Completed
description: Event emitted when a corporate account migration rollback process completes.

migration_id.title: Migration ID
migration_id.description: The unique identifier of the migration that was rolled back.

code.title: Code
code.description: A code identifying the specific result or error of the rollback operation.

message.title: Message
message.description: A human-readable message describing the result of the rollback operation.

status.title: Status
status.description: The result status of the rollback operation.

pismo_metadata.title: Pismo Metadata
pismo_metadata.description: Additional metadata from Pismo related to the rollback operation.
